**Build passes now.** Exit `0`, 0 errors.

Two real bugs, both from the bump:

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Read both, default `0` |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag is now `undefined` | Treat unset as off |

The 8 warnings are still printed. They are hardcoded strings in [build.js:18](build.js:18) and lines 46 to 48. No source file backs them.

Next: nothing, unless you want those warning lines cut too.
